import json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
errs=[]
def ok(c,m):
    print(("PASS " if c else "FAIL ")+m)

    b=p.chromium.launch(); pg=b.new_page()
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errs.append("JS "+str(e)))

    A=lambda expr: pg.evaluate("()=>{const a=window.shopTestAPI;return "+expr+"}")
    A("a.reset()")
    st=A("a.getState()")
    ok(len(st["products"])==8 and len(st["orders"])==9, "seed")
    ok({o["status"] for o in st["orders"]}=={"pending","paid","shipped","cancelled"}, "statuses")
    ok(any(o["refundedAmount"]>0 and o["status"]!="cancelled" for o in st["orders"]), "partial refund seed")
    stock=lambda sku: [v["stock"] for p_ in A("a.getState()")["products"] for v in p_["variants"] if v["sku"]==sku][0]
    ok(not A("a.addToCart('DIM-GLOW',1)")["ok"], "no stock blocked")
    ok(not A("a.addToCart('SKP-1000',2)")["ok"], "over stock blocked")
    ok(not A("a.addToCart('MOL-1',0)")["ok"] and not A("a.addToCart('MOL-1',1.5)")["ok"] and not A("a.addToCart('MOL-1',-1)")["ok"], "illegal qty")
    ok(A("a.addToCart('MOL-1',3)")["ok"], "add")
    ok(A("a.addToCart('LAB-PNK',1)")["ok"], "add2")
    c=A("a.getCart()"); ok(c["subtotal"]==306 and c["total"]==306, "cart total %s"%c)
    ok(A("a.applyCoupon('MJ20')")["ok"], "coupon")
    A("a.setMember(true)")
    c=A("a.getCart()"); print(c); ok(c["total"]==round(306-15.3-20,2), "stacked")
    ok(not A("a.applyCoupon('MJ50')")["ok"], "coupon threshold")
    ok(A("a.setCartQty('MOL-1',1)")["ok"], "setqty")
    c=A("a.getCart()"); ok(all(d["type"]!="coupon" for d in c["discounts"]), "coupon dropped %s"%c)
    ok(not A("a.setCartQty('MOL-1',999)")["ok"], "setqty over")
    A("a.setCartQty('MOL-1',3)"); A("a.applyCoupon('MJ20')")
    s0=stock('MOL-1')
    ok(not A("a.checkout({name:'',phone:'123',address:'x'})")["ok"], "bad addr")
    # UI confirm flow with double click
    r=A("a.prepareCheckout({name:'张三',phone:'13800000000',address:'上海市浦东新区世纪大道1号'})"); ok(r["ok"],"prepare")
    n0=len(A("a.getState()")["orders"])
    btn=pg.locator('[data-testid=confirm-order]'); ok(btn.is_visible(),"confirm visible")
    btn.click(); btn.click(); pg.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=confirm-order]').click()")
    st=A("a.getState()"); ok(len(st["orders"])==n0+1, "single order")
    ok(stock('MOL-1')==s0-3, "stock deducted once")
    o=[x for x in st["orders"]][-1]; oid=o["id"]; print(o)
    ok(o["payable"]==round(306-15.3-20,2) and A("a.getCart()")["lines"]==[], "order amt & cart cleared")
    ok(not A("a.ship('%s')"%oid)["ok"], "cannot ship pending")
    ok(A("a.pay('%s')"%oid)["ok"] and not A("a.pay('%s')"%oid)["ok"], "pay once")
    ok(A("a.ship('%s')"%oid)["ok"], "ship")
    ok(not A("a.cancel('%s')"%oid)["ok"], "no cancel shipped")
    r=A("a.requestAfterSale('%s',[{sku:'MOL-1',qty:4}],{returnGoods:true})"%oid); ok(not r["ok"],"over qty")
    s1=stock('MOL-1')
    r=A("a.requestAfterSale('%s',[{sku:'MOL-1',qty:1}],{returnGoods:true})"%oid); print(r)
    ok(r["ok"] and r["amount"]==round(69*270.7/306+1e-9,2), "refund prorated")
    ok(stock('MOL-1')==s1, "no restock on request")
    rid=r["refundId"]
    ok(A("a.confirmReturn('%s')"%rid)["ok"] and stock('MOL-1')==s1+1, "restock")
    ok(not A("a.confirmReturn('%s')"%rid)["ok"] and stock('MOL-1')==s1+1, "no double restock")
    r2=A("a.requestAfterSale('%s',[{sku:'MOL-1',qty:2},{sku:'LAB-PNK',qty:1}],{returnGoods:false})"%oid)
    o=[x for x in A("a.getState()")["orders"] if x["id"]==oid][0]
    ok(r2["ok"] and abs(o["refundedAmount"]-o["payable"])<1e-9, "final refund = remaining")
    ok(not A("a.requestAfterSale('%s',[{sku:'MOL-1',qty:1}],{})"%oid)["ok"], "nothing left")
    stats=A("a.getStats()"); print(stats)
    ok(stats["unitsSold"].get('MOL-1',0)>=0 and abs(stats["net"]-(stats["sales"]-stats["refunds"]))<1e-6, "stats")
    # cancel flow
    A("a.setMember(false)"); A("a.addToCart('HIR-6',2)"); s2=stock('HIR-6')
    r=A("a.checkout({name:'李四',phone:'13900000000',address:'北京市海淀区'})"); oid2=r["orderId"]
    ok(stock('HIR-6')==s2-2,"deduct")
    ok(A("a.cancel('%s')"%oid2)["ok"] and stock('HIR-6')==s2, "cancel release")
    ok(not A("a.cancel('%s')"%oid2)["ok"] and stock('HIR-6')==s2, "no double release")
    # paid cancel
    A("a.addToCart('BOX-3',1)"); oid3=A("a.checkout({name:'王五',phone:'13700000000',address:'深圳南山'})")["orderId"]; A("a.pay('%s')"%oid3)
    st0=A("a.getStats()"); A("a.cancel('%s')"%oid3); st1=A("a.getStats()")
    o=[x for x in A("a.getState()")["orders"] if x["id"]==oid3][0]
    ok(o["refundedAmount"]==239 and len(o["refunds"])==1 and st1["sales"]==st0["sales"] and abs(st1["refunds"]-st0["refunds"]-239)<1e-6,"paid cancel refund")
    q=A("a.queryOrders({status:'cancelled'})"); ok(all(x["status"]=="cancelled" for x in q) and len(q)>=4,"query status")
    ok(len(A("a.queryOrders({from:'2026-09-01',to:'2026-09-30'})"))==2,"query date")
    ok(len(A("a.queryOrders({sku:'HIR-6'})"))>=3,"query sku")
    ok(len(A("a.queryOrders({orderId:'%s'})"%oid))==1,"query id")
    # export/import
    ex=A("a.exportData()"); before=A("a.getState()")
    ok(not A("a.importData('{bad')")["ok"] and not A("a.importData(JSON.stringify({products:[]}))")["ok"], "bad import")
    d=json.loads(ex); del d["orders"]
    ok(not pg.evaluate("s=>window.shopTestAPI.importData(s)", json.dumps(d))["ok"], "incomplete import")
    ok(A("a.getState()")==before, "unchanged after bad import")
    A("a.reset()")
    ok(pg.evaluate("s=>window.shopTestAPI.importData(s)", ex)["ok"], "import ok")
    after=A("a.getState()"); ok(after["orders"]==before["orders"] and after["products"]==before["products"], "roundtrip")
    pg.reload(); ok(A("a.getState()")["orders"]==before["orders"], "persist reload")
    # UI flow: add to cart via UI, checkout via UI
    A("a.reset()"); pg.reload()
    pg.fill('#fQ','Pucky'); pg.click('[data-act=addCart][data-pid=P08]')
    ok(A("a.getCart()")["lines"][0]["sku"]=="PUC-STD","ui add")
    pg.click('[data-act=goCheckout]'); pg.fill('#ckName','赵六'); pg.fill('#ckPhone','1380000'); pg.click('[data-act=ckNext]')
    ok(pg.locator('.ferr').nth(1).inner_text()!="","ui phone err")
    pg.fill('#ckPhone','13800001111'); pg.fill('#ckAddr','成都市武侯区'); pg.click('[data-act=ckNext]')
    pg.click('[data-testid=confirm-order]'); ok(len(A("a.getState()")["orders"])==10,"ui order")
    pg.click('#sheet [data-act=closeSheet] >> nth=0')
    pg.click('nav button[data-tab=orders]'); pg.fill('#oProd','Pucky')
    pg.click('#orderTable [data-act=pay] >> nth=0'); pg.click('[data-act=confirmYes]')
    pg.click('#orderTable [data-act=ship] >> nth=0'); pg.click('[data-act=confirmYes]')
    pg.screenshot(path='/tmp/s1.png',full_page=True)
    pg.click('nav button[data-tab=aftersale]'); pg.screenshot(path='/tmp/s2.png',full_page=True)
    pg.click('nav button[data-tab=stats]'); pg.screenshot(path='/tmp/s3.png',full_page=True)
    pg.click('nav button[data-tab=shop]'); pg.screenshot(path='/tmp/s0.png',full_page=True)
    b.close()
print("ERRORS:",errs)

  - 已付款：发货、取消并退款、申请售后
  - 已发货：申请售后
  - 已取消：无操作

## 优惠规则
- 会员 95 折，按商品原价合计计算，四舍五入到分。
- 满减券有三张：满 199 减 20、满 399 减 50、满 999 减 120。是否达到门槛也按原价合计判断。
- 会员折扣和满减可以叠加，每单只能用一张券。
- 实付 = 原价合计 − 会员折扣 − 满减。

## 初始数据
8 个商品、16 个规格（含一个售罄规格和多个低库存规格），以及 9 笔历史订单，覆盖：
- 待付款
- 已付款（其中一笔未发货就部分退了款）
- 已发货（一笔退货已入库，一笔退货待入库，一笔没有售后）
- 待付款时取消
- 付款后取消并自动退款

## 已知限制
- 付款、退款都是本地模拟，没有登录和店员权限区分。
- 数据存在当前浏览器的本地存储里。换浏览器、清除浏览器数据或开无痕窗口都会丢失，需要定期导出备份。
- 没做商品和优惠券的管理界面。改价格、改库存要编辑导出的文件后再导入，导入前会先完整校验。
- 有几处规则是我自己定的，需求里没写明：
  - 已付款但还没发货的订单申请退款时，库存会立刻释放，因为货还没发出，不需要等退货入库。
  - 购物车数量设为 0 会被视为非法，删除商品要点"移除"。
  - 购物车未达门槛时不能使用满减券。
- 日期筛选按电脑本地时区的下单日期计算。
